visualCharacteristics.purpose: Side-by-side campaign promo tiles, each with text and a CTA overlaid on a darkened full-bleed photo
visualCharacteristics.layout: Two equal tiles in a row on desktop, stacked on mobile; photo fills each tile behind the text

contentPattern.structure: first cell: background image; second cell: heading, paragraph and a CTA link

usage: Use for two (or more) promotional tiles that pair a photo backdrop with a short call to action.
reuseGuidance: Reuse whenever promo text sits on top of its photo. For image-above-text cards use cards-news or the base cards block.
